jess_cs: Heads-up: StellarAI onboarding seeing short 429 surge for ~20s after deploy. They run Node Lambdas that call Redwood.initialize() in handler and then immediately fan out. About 8 concurrent cold starts. Any quick playbook?

arjun_eng: Sounds like a token/preflight stampede. Which auth flow?

jess_cs: Ephemeral JWTs from their auth service per instance. Logs show multiple 429s with X-RateLimit-Remaining:0 right after deploy.

lee_platform: Quick mitigations to send them: (1) Set PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=1 during warmup to serialize preflight calls. (2) Add a small randomized init jitter (0-300ms) before initialize(). (3) Enable SDK ephemeralTokenCache or a simple /tmp single-flight cache per container so tokens are reused. (4) Upgrade to Node SDK v0.9+ if possible (fixes concurrent-init backoff).

arjun_eng: Example snippet: 
```
const jitter = Math.floor(Math.random()*300);
await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,jitter));
await Redwood.initialize({ ephemeralTokenCache: true });
```

jess_cs: Sent to customer; they applied PREFETCH_CONCURRENCY=1 + jitter and saw immediate improvement. They asked if we can relax server-side enforcement briefly for new accounts.

lee_platform: We can offer a manual short onboarding quota bump, but for fastest fix client-side is best. I'll file a follow-up ticket to track SDK upgrade nudges.

infra-bot: Ticket CS-11007 created to follow up on SDK upgrades and onboarding quota flow.

jess_cs: Thanks all — closing unless they reopen.
